flow: guided patch-first: read agent -> patch-data (exec_summary) -> validate -> snapshot

errors.what: first patch-data attempt used a nonexistent --set flag
errors.recovered_by: checked --help; patch-data uses a JSON Merge Patch file, authored a minimal {exec_summary} patch

errors.what: Get-Content/PowerShell command initially routed through bash

problems_and_friction: patch-data needs a JSON file (no inline --set), so I authored a one-key RFC 7396 merge patch; the apostrophe serialized as \u0027 but decodes correctly. validate emitted a pack-html 'next' hint that is forbidden for this data-bound field, so I ignored it.
context_understood: exec_summary is a data-bound {{key}} field, so patching shared data alone updates the rendered HTML without touching the human view.
